topic: What are the trade-offs in using additive manufacturing for CTS array fabrication versus traditional methods in terms of deployment cost and scalability?
consensus_response: Additive manufacturing (AM) offers design flexibility and reduced assembly costs but introduces surface roughness, affecting performance. Traditional methods provide precision but limit complexity. Material selection and thermal management impact performance, with AM suited for complex designs and traditional methods for simpler structures, influencing deployment cost and scalability.
reference_context: Additive manufacturing enables monolithic complex designs, reducing size, weight, and cost, but may introduce surface roughness affecting microwave performance.
